subject: radiopt=1 in not working in MMPBSA.py

messages.author: Abdul Basit
messages.body:
Dear users and developers
I am performing MMPBSA calculations in Amber16, I got the following error
*PB Bomb in pb_aaradi(): No radius assigned for atom 1 N NL*
I have generated topology files using ff15ipq forcefield. Can anybody tell
me the reason?
Sincerely
Abdul Basit
Research Fellow
School of Computational & Integrative Sciences
Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi-110067
India

messages.author: Ray Luo
messages.body:
Hi Abdul,
Indeed, we haven't tested ff15ipq for radiopt=1 for mmpbsa calculations. In
the meantime, please use radiopt=0 instead.
All the best,
Ray
--
Ray Luo, Ph.D.
Professor of Structural Biology/Biochemistry/Biophysics,
Chemical and Materials Physics, Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering,
Biomedical Engineering, and Materials Science and Engineering
